senses.gloss: f. (חָפַן) the priest’s taking handfuls of incense (Lev. XVI, 12).
units: Yoma 19ᵃ top ללמדו ח׳ (they took him to the house of Abtinas) to teach him the manipulation of ḥăfinah.
<cite ref="Yoma 49a:17">Ib. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>בחֲפִינָתוֹ</he> with what the dying highpriest had seized with his hands.
Men. 11ᵃ והאיכא ח׳ is there not ḥăfinah among the difficult priestly functions?; a. e.
